final_answer:
Meta's FY2024 10-K reports Revenue of $164,501 million and Income from operations of $69,380 million [DOC-1]. Dividing income from operations by revenue: $69,380M / $164,501M ≈ 42.2%.

These figures are directly comparable, as both come from the same fiscal year (FY2024) within the same consolidated statement of income in the same filing [DOC-1].

ANSWER: Approximately 42.2% (Income from operations of $69,380M ÷ Revenue of $164,501M)
